edges.reason: tx.origin is assigned to owner inside the VictoriaVR constructor, giving the transaction origin privileged control.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] is set to uint(-1) during construction, an unlimited approval tied to tx.origin.
block.timestamp is read inside list and therefore makes execution time dependent.
block.timestamp + 600 flows into the addLiquidityETH deadline argument.
pancakeRouter state variable is the receiver of the addLiquidityETH call.
wrappedBinance address is passed into pairForPancake during construction.
totalSupply flows into the unchecked multiplication and division in list().
balanceOf mapping is decremented with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
balanceOf mapping is incremented with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
allowance mapping is read and mutated inside VictoriaVR.transferFrom.
stopTheBots address is the target of the low-level call inside the checkBots modifier.
stopTheBots address is the target of the low-level call inside distribute.
stopTheBots address is the target of the low-level call inside list.
uniPair is encoded into the payload of the checkBots external call.
msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument when transfer calls transferFrom.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
the checkBots modifier wraps the transferFrom body and gates its execution.
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether allowance must be spent.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
the checkBots modifier performs an external low-level call before the protected function executes its state changes.
the untrusted stopTheBots call executes before balance and allowance updates in transferFrom, allowing reentrant execution.
distribute makes an external call to stopTheBots before writing balances.
list makes an external call to stopTheBots before distributing balances.
delegate forwards arbitrary calldata into a delegatecall.
delegatecall transfers execution to an arbitrary address that can call back into the contract.
delegate is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
distribute is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
list is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
ERC20.transfer calls the internal _transfer helper.
ERC20.transferFrom calls the internal _transfer helper.
ERC20.transferFrom calls the internal _approve helper after spending allowance.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub to protect the sender balance decrement.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add to increase the recipient balance.
msg.sender is used as the spender inside ERC20.transferFrom allowance logic.
msg.sender is used as the sender inside ERC20.transfer.
distribute compares msg.sender against owner.
list compares msg.sender against owner.
delegate compares msg.sender against owner.
owner state variable is the authority checked in delegate.
owner state variable is the authority checked in distribute.
owner state variable is the authority checked in list.
the constructor assigns uniPair by calling pairForPancake.
the constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the pancakeRouter state variable.
the constructor calls pairForPancake to derive the pair address.
the constructor sets owner from tx.origin, making ownership dependent on the transaction origin.
the external addLiquidityETH call in list executes before the balance distribution loop, enabling reentrancy.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter is only consumed when storing the stopTheBots state variable inside BotProtected.
_from exists solely as an argument of the checkBots external call.
_to exists solely as an argument of the checkBots external call.
_value exists solely as an argument of the checkBots external call.
The parameter is forwarded to the BotProtected constructor and has no other use.
_to is only used as the recipient argument forwarded to transferFrom.
_value is only used as the amount argument forwarded to transferFrom.
_from drives the allowance and balance bookkeeping inside transferFrom.
_to is the recipient whose balance is credited inside transferFrom.
_value is the amount used in the unchecked arithmetic of transferFrom.
a is the target address of the delegatecall performed inside delegate.
b is the arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall inside delegate.
tokenA is only used to order the tokens for the create2 hash computation.
tokenB is only used to order the tokens for the create2 hash computation.
pair is the local result computed and returned by pairForPancake.
_toAddresses is iterated over to write balances and emit transfers in distribute.
amount is the fixed balance value assigned inside the distribute loop.
i is the loop counter of the distribution loop inside distribute.
_numList sets the contract balance and the liquidity amounts in list.
_toAddresses is iterated over to distribute balances in list.
_amounts supplies the per-address balance values used in the list loop.
i is the loop counter of the distribution loop inside list.
